description:
Not part of the webhook audit trail itself, but found while designing it (2026-10-15): detection is not prevention. Work is in xpmatteo/agbredo-pipelines (../pipelines), file .github/workflows/agent-instructions-audit.yml. Talk with Matt before building: this changes the pipeline's trust boundary and how it is released.

## Problem

Claude in the "Audit with Claude" step can reach a token that can write to the repository:
- `GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}` is set in the job-level `env`, so it is in the environment of every step, Claude's included.
- `github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}` is passed to anthropics/claude-code-action.
- actions/checkout keeps the token in .git/config by default (persist-credentials: true), and Claude's allowed tools include Read and `Bash(cat:*)`.
- The job has `contents: write` and `pull-requests: write`.
Only `--allowedTools` stops Claude from pushing or opening a PR itself. The agent should not be able to escalate outside the scripted path.

## Direction (to agree with Matt)

- Split into two jobs. Job "audit": `contents: read`, `id-token: write` (telemetry), `actions: read`; checkout with `persist-credentials: false`; no GH_TOKEN in Claude's environment; Claude writes its edits and .audit/ files; upload them as an artifact. Job "publish": `needs: audit`, `contents: write`, `pull-requests: write`; downloads the artifact, re-checks that only CLAUDE.md, README.md and .audit/ changed, runs file-questions and open-pr.
- Check whether claude-code-action needs `github_token` at all in prompt mode; if it must have one, give it the read-only job token.
- Set GH_TOKEN only on the steps that call gh (gate, file-questions, open-pr).
- Callers keep granting the same permissions (a called workflow can only narrow them), so no caller change.

## How to check

A test run on a branch (see README "Versions" for testing a branch end to end) where the audit still opens its PR; and a check that in the audit job `cat .git/config` and `env` show no token.
title: Pipelines: give Claude no write token in the audit pipeline
